text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having decided to train completely separately from Satono Diamond, Kitasan Black...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haah...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (Dia-chan... isn't here... Dia-chan... isn't chasing me from behind...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Just that makes it feel so different!
Uuu~)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ripped away from her other half, an Umamusume
who had been like an inseparable sister to her,
she was visibly out of sorts.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer.
I've gotten totally slack, haven't I!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even though I decided to do my best first as Dia-chan's big sister figure~
choice_data_list: Still, wouldn't it be hard to work with, honestly?
Still, wouldn't it be hard to work with, honestly?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Well, that's true...
Ever since we were little, I've based a lot of my thinking on Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll work harder than Dia-chan.
What would Dia-chan do? I'm always thinking like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond isn't just a childhood friend. She's also a guiding light whenever I run...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she's been separated from an Umamusume like that, it's only natural for her heart to waver. In that case...
choice_data_list: Hang on a sec, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Trainer, where are you going...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided to take action as a Trainer. In order to resolve this situation...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even you went away, Trainer...
Uuu, now I'm all alone...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't settle down~. I mean,
I've always been with someone wherever I went.
Ayy ayyy☆ Then Kita-chan, wanna hype it up with us!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh...
Ah, Daitaku Helios-san...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Good day!
Thank you so much for your help at the freshman welcome party!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey hey, or should I say, long time no see! And I didn't come alone, either! C'mon in, bestie!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm here too! Ayyy!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo is here too! Going full throttle today too!
That's right, the three of us—

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: The Runaway Trio☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The Runaway Trio...! Ah, that's right.
All three are upperclassmen who specialize as front runners!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That's right! If you're struggling with front-running,
you can always talk to us!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that I'm troubled about running as a Front Runner,
my motivation is just, like, kinda meh~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, feeling down and having a cry?
Then yo! Let's hype it up with us, yo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, from the looks of it,
maybe getting hyped isn't what's needed here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What you're lacking isn't momentum, but maybe...
a partner to run alongside you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... If anything, that's true...
But Palmer, why...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Just a feeling. Rather than being troubled, it looked more like you were at a loss for what to do."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I was separated from Dia-chan,
whom I've always trained with and encouraged each other.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, gotcha. Then hey, wanna just hang with us for now?
The more the merrier!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You'll be our new runaway buddy! We're gonna run wild together!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"R-Rampage...! Sounds a bit extreme,
but if you'll let me join you!"
Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that voice...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I returned to the training grounds accompanied
by the Umamusume best suited to provide
support for Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: If that's what this is about, I'd like you to leave it to us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-T-Teio-san!? Don't tell me your Trainer is...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And then, one more person...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello there.
Nice Nature in the flesh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just came to pick the three of you up.
Ikuno told me to go call you over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Nice Nature.
She's in Tokai Teio's generation and gets along well
with the runaway front-runner trio, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who gathered decided to discuss
what course of action would be best for Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You see, Kita-chan is so earnest,
I don't think reckless tactics or running styles
really suit her that well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So you really should study all kinds of things
with McQueen and me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You thought so too, Trainer, and that's why you came to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... studying all sorts of things, huh.
What do you think, Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as for me...
Considering the strengths of both sides...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. If I had to choose, I think it'd be better to follow Teio.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Why's that? Kita-chan is suited for leading,
so why, why?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: She might be suited for running in front, but Kita-chan's front-running style isn't an all-or-nothing gamble like yours, is it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like you're locked into being a pure Front Runner yet, either.
So I think it'd be good to gain various experiences
under Teio and learn different ways of running."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think that's for the best.
Yeah, I think that would be better.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Nice Nature said, Kitasan Black's running style
isn't a reckless gamble of a front-runner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She takes the lead while remaining aware of those behind her, using her toughness and guts to hold out until the very end. If possible, I'd like her to learn a running style that isn't fixated solely on leading."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I have no objections.
Her own future comes first, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha☆ Well, as long as Kita-chan's vibes are up,
then it's all good in the hood!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Well then, Kita-chan, let's hang out again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you're ever in trouble, you can come by anytime!
Turbo will be waiting for ya!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, thank you very much!
Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished talking with her seniors,
Kitasan Black—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Welcome, Kita-san. Allow me to introduce myself once more: I am Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was warmly welcomed by Tokai Teio's friend,
Mejiro McQueen, the prestigious Mejiro family's famed stayer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It seems they wish to learn all sorts of things
from us. Of course, they are most welcome."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There's Spe-chan and lots of other girls too,
so feel free to ask anything whenever you need to.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So, Kita-chan? Think you can fit in and get along with us upperclassmen?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I-It feels like a dream! Getting taught
by Teio-san and McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm Kitasan Black! As the newcomer,
I'll do anything—carry bags, mop floors,
you name it! So, please...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pleaaase take care of meee!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You don't have to scrub the floors
or anything, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Kitasan Black gained a new circle of support.
